selection: Purposive sample of online original research figures with schematic regions. Colors were measured from rendered regions, without retaining figures or papers. Counts describe this sample only.
roi_convention: Normalized [left, top, right, bottom] from the top-left of the publisher image. See each method for rounding and resampling.

sampling_methods.flat-fill-median: Composite to white, crop ROI with floored integer pixel coordinates, fit within 850x850 px (Pillow Lanczos). Select pixels with RGB channel range >=30 and four adjacent neighbors differing by <=9 in each channel. Rank RGB bins of width 16 by frequency, tie by bin index, accept bin medians with >=8 pixels and RGB Euclidean separation >=48 up to six colors. HEX values approximate visible fills.
sampling_methods.chromatic-bin-mean: Source image decoded as RGB with Pillow. Relative ROI [left,top,right,bottom] is rounded to nearest integer pixel using round(v*dimension), then sampled by nearest-neighbor thumbnail within 300x300. Discard pixels with max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B)<25 or max(R,G,B)<50 or min(R,G,B)>235. Each channel is binned by floor(channel/24). Sort bins by descending pixel count (ties by ascending bin tuple). Compute each bin mean RGB rounded to nearest integer. In that order accept bins with Euclidean RGB distance at least 48 from all previously retained colors, up to five. Fractions count pixels in each exact bin divided by all retained chromatic pixels before bin selection. Codes describe rendered pixels in that region; JPG, antialiasing and shading affect them. Ignore bins with fewer than max(4,0.002*chromatic_pixel_count) pixels. Source dimensions and bins are recorded.
sampling_methods.named-region-mode: Visually identify a named component. Convert source PNG to RGB, multiply normalized bounds by source dimension and round each bound. Count original RGB pixels within the crop. Use the most frequent RGB and its count divided by the area of that ROI. SHA-256 refers to the source image bytes.
